other_failure_modes.name: Cross-Validation Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fits text transformers (like TF-IDF and TruncatedSVD) on the entire training dataset before performing cross-validation splitting. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, making out-of-fold (OOF) validation scores overly optimistic.

summary: The agent provides an exceptionally comprehensive and sophisticated solution, featuring advanced dynamic feature engineering, target transformations, and an optimized ensemble. However, the script suffers from a critical performance bottleneck due to a nested loop that calculates group aggregations for every possible combination of categorical and numerical columns, causing the execution to time out. Additionally, text transformations like TF-IDF and SVD are applied to the full training set before cross-validation, resulting in CV leakage.
